events.title: Paperclip adds auditable private work and exact agent cost controls
events.title_zh: Paperclip 加入可审计私密任务与精确成本控制
events.summary: Paperclip v2026.1023.0 adds private tasks and projects, audited break-glass access, bring-your-own model gateways and an exact cost ledger for multi-agent operations. Unpriced models fail closed for budget enforcement. Expanded Operator permissions are a breaking change that requires a role review before upgrade.
events.why_it_matters: For teams operating multiple coding agents, permission boundaries and cost attribution now share one control plane. The project is still moving quickly, so upgrade compatibility and audit completeness need a controlled trial.

Unpriced models fail closed for budget enforcement. Expanded Operator permissions are a breaking change that requires a role review before upgrade.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对运行多个 coding agent 的团队来说，权限边界和成本归因终于进入同一控制面。它仍是快速演进的开源项目，先验证升级兼容与审计完整性。

events.title: Nanbeige releases an open 33B model with a 512K context window
events.title_zh: Nanbeige 开放 33B 模型并提供 512K 上下文
events.summary: Nanbeige released Apache-2.0 weights for Nanbeige4.3-33B with a 512K context window and deployment paths for Transformers, SGLang and vLLM. The model card reports coding and office-task results, but evaluation is publisher-only and adoption is still very early.
events.why_it_matters: For teams that need local long-context and coding capability, this is a directly downloadable candidate. Its 512K memory footprint, effective retrieval length and publisher benchmarks need verification on a real repository.
events.summary_zh: Nanbeige 发布 Nanbeige4.3-33B 的 Apache-2.0 权重，支持 512K 上下文，并给出 Transformers、SGLang 与 vLLM 的部署方法。模型卡列出代码和办公任务成绩，但目前只有发布方评测，下载采用信号也仍很早。

events.why_it_matters_zh: 对需要本地长上下文和 coding 能力的团队来说，这是可直接下载的候选项。512K 的内存占用、有效检索长度和发布方 benchmark 需要在真实仓库上复核。

events.title: Beetle publishes a multilingual suite for testing learning curricula
events.title_zh: Beetle 发布多语种学习课程实验套件
events.summary: Beetle publishes 330 small models across 21 languages, thousands of checkpoints, training data and curriculum-learning code. It compares five curricula at three token budgets and reports that staged curricula better match human second-language reading times.
events.why_it_matters: The artifacts turn multilingual training-order claims into reproducible experiments. Results come from small models and controlled corpora and should not be extrapolated directly to frontier-scale systems.
events.summary_zh: Beetle 公开 21 种语言的 330 个小模型、数千个 checkpoint、训练数据和课程实验代码。它用 5 种课程和 3 档 token 预算比较多语种学习顺序，并报告分阶段课程更贴近人类二语阅读时间。
events.summary_en: Beetle publishes 330 small models across 21 languages, thousands of checkpoints, training data and curriculum-learning code. It compares five curricula at three token budgets and reports that staged curricula better match human second-language reading times.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 这套产物让多语训练顺序从单篇论文变成可重复实验。结论来自小模型与受控语料，不能直接外推到前沿大模型。
events.why_it_matters_en: The artifacts turn multilingual training-order claims into reproducible experiments. Results come from small models and controlled corpora and should not be extrapolated directly to frontier-scale systems.

events.title: Meta opens InteractiveWorld and a state-verifiable multimodal benchmark
events.title_zh: Meta 开放 InteractiveWorld 与状态可验证多模态评测
events.summary: Meta released a stateful first-person 3D simulator and InteractiveBench with 120 frozen multi-turn tasks across six categories. Success is checked against world state, but the rubric still requires human adjudication. Reproduction needs Linux, an NVIDIA GPU, about 100 GB of assets and separately licensed Isaac Sim, BEHAVIOR, MANO and AMASS components.
events.why_it_matters: State-based checks can expose whether a multimodal agent actually changed the environment rather than narrated success. The non-commercial license, gated assets and high setup cost make it a watch item until cheaper reproduction or transfer evidence appears.
events.summary_zh: Meta 公开有状态的第一人称 3D 模拟器和 InteractiveBench，包含六类、120 个冻结的多轮任务。成功条件会对照世界状态，但评分规则仍需要人工裁定。复现要求 Linux、NVIDIA GPU、约 100 GB 资产，以及另行授权的 Isaac Sim、BEHAVIOR、MANO 和 AMASS 组件。
events.summary_en: Meta released a stateful first-person 3D simulator and InteractiveBench with 120 frozen multi-turn tasks across six categories. Success is checked against world state, but the rubric still requires human adjudication. Reproduction needs Linux, an NVIDIA GPU, about 100 GB of assets and separately licensed Isaac Sim, BEHAVIOR, MANO and AMASS components.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 基于世界状态的检查可以区分 agent 是否真的改变了环境，而不是只用文字声称成功。非商业许可证、受限资产与高搭建成本使它目前更适合 WATCH，等待更便宜的复现或真实设备迁移证据。
events.why_it_matters_en: State-based checks can expose whether a multimodal agent actually changed the environment rather than narrated success. The non-commercial license, gated assets and high setup cost make it a watch item until cheaper reproduction or transfer evidence appears.

events.title: PaperPilot draws attention before publishing a stable release or benchmarks
events.title_zh: PaperPilot 在稳定版与实测数据缺席时快速升温
events.summary: PaperPilot packages local PDF operations behind CLI, MCP, REST, WASM and desktop surfaces. Its v0.6.0 release is explicitly prerelease, and the repository benchmark section still contains a placeholder instead of measured results. The repository reached roughly 500 stars during recall review.
events.why_it_matters: For teams evaluating local document tooling, the multi-surface architecture is interesting but current community attention is ahead of release maturity and evidence. The project should not receive engineering time until it ships a stable release, reproducible benchmarks and tests for claimed privacy and sanitization boundaries.
events.summary_zh: PaperPilot 把本地 PDF 操作封装成 CLI、MCP、REST、WASM 与桌面端。v0.6.0 明确标为 prerelease，仓库 benchmark 章节仍是占位内容，没有实测结果。召回复核时仓库约有 500 stars。
events.summary_en: PaperPilot packages local PDF operations behind CLI, MCP, REST, WASM and desktop surfaces. Its v0.6.0 release is explicitly prerelease, and the repository benchmark section still contains a placeholder instead of measured results. The repository reached roughly 500 stars during recall review.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对评估本地文档工具的团队来说，多入口架构有意思，但社区热度已经跑在版本成熟度与证据前面。等到稳定版、可复现 benchmark，以及对隐私和净化边界的测试出现后再投入。
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams evaluating local document tooling, the multi-surface architecture is interesting but current community attention is ahead of release maturity and evidence. The project should not receive engineering time until it ships a stable release, reproducible benchmarks and tests for claimed privacy and sanitization boundaries.
